_comment: loom configuration. Copy to loom.config.json next to loom.sh (or pass --config). Paths are relative to paths.repo_root, which defaults to the git top level of this file's directory.

_paths_help.mcp_allowlist: Optional markdown file with a '## Approved servers' table (name | endpoint | ...). When set, loom refuses to run if any canonical server or endpoint is not in it.
_paths_help.spec_packs: Optional directory of dated spec packs (harness-specs/). Enables the staleness warning and defaults gaps_file to <spec_packs>/GAPS.md.
_paths_help.gaps_file: Where the generated capability-gap ledger goes. Empty and no spec_packs: gaps are printed to stderr instead.
_paths_help.manifest: Optional file where loom records the list of emitted files; --check uses it to flag generated files that regeneration no longer produces (orphans). Empty: disabled. install.sh pre-fills it to <specs-dir>/loom-manifest.txt.
_paths_help.loom_script: How generated headers refer to the script, e.g. 'agent/tools/loom.sh'. Defaults to the script's path relative to repo_root.
_paths_help.loom_config: How generated headers refer to this file. Defaults to its path relative to repo_root.

_mcp_note_help: Optional free text written as a comment into adapters that allow comments (Codex). Use it for the policy sentence your reviewers expect to see, e.g. 'All listed servers are read-only documentation services; tool calls are pre-approved per the allowlist.'

compensating_controls.hooks: git pre-commit hooks + CI running the same scripts
compensating_controls.permissions: manual approval inside the harness session

_mcp_overrides_help: Per-harness transport overrides keyed by server name. Devin's HTTP client fails on servers that reject its discovery GET; route those through a pinned stdio bridge. '{{url}}' is replaced with the canonical endpoint. Remove the _example entry.
